apropos.subtitle: Business management application — v{{version}}
apropos.bakeryText: Boulangerie Lomoto produces and distributes fresh bread every day: counter sales, depositors and reselling "Maman" clients. This application covers the cash register, customer orders and commissions, stock and production, supplier purchases and the team — with real-time notifications tailored to each role.

PREVISION.label: Forecast
PREVISION.description: Quantity announced by the client on D for a delivery on D+1 (Order clerk) — creates no sale and no debt.

RETENUE_PRODUCTION.label: Held for production
RETENUE_PRODUCTION.description: Quantity held for production, possibly different from the announced quantity (Production).

PREPAREE.label: Prepared
PREPAREE.description: Quantity prepared for delivery, not yet handed to the Store (C4 status PREPAREE).

REMISE_MAGASIN.label: Handed to Store
REMISE_MAGASIN.description: Quantity handed from Production to the Store (C4 status REMISE_MAGASIN). This transition proves the internal handoff, not that the client received it.

CHARGEE.label: Loaded
CHARGEE.description: Quantity handed to the driver for the round (Store) — does not prove the client received it.

EN_TOURNEE.label: On the road
EN_TOURNEE.description: The driver is transporting the delivery (C4 status EN_TOURNEE) — no receipt is confirmed yet.

EN_ATTENTE_CONFIRMATION.label: Awaiting confirmation
EN_ATTENTE_CONFIRMATION.description: The drop-off at the client happened (SIGNALER_DEPOT action), but the accepted quantity is not yet confirmed. No financial effect.

previsions.statutsFinauxTitre: Final cycle status (exactly one of the four applies)

PARTIELLEMENT_ACCEPTEE.label: Partially accepted
PARTIELLEMENT_ACCEPTEE.description: Final status when the cycle's total accepted quantity is greater than zero but lower than the total dropped-off quantity. The accepted, returned and missing quantities remain displayed separately.

ACCEPTEE.label: Fully accepted
ACCEPTEE.description: Final status when the entire dropped-off quantity is accepted.

RETOUR_TOTAL.label: Fully returned
RETOUR_TOTAL.description: Final status when nothing is accepted — the accepted total is zero, no order is created (C4 contract §7).

ANNULEE.label: Cancelled
ANNULEE.description: Final status when the cycle is cancelled before confirmation.

previsions.resultatsTitre: Delivery results (distinct quantities, shown in parallel)

accepte.label: Accepted
accepte.description: Quantity confirmed by the client or an authorized role — the only billable basis. Entered separately from returns; accepted + returned can never exceed the dropped-off quantity.

retourne.label: Returned
retourne.description: Quantity taken back, not accepted — stays visible, never billed. Entered separately from accepted; accepted + returned can never exceed the dropped-off quantity.

manquant.label: Missing
manquant.description: Gap computed by the server: loaded minus dropped off. Stays visible, never billed, never entered by the client.

facturable.label: Billable
facturable.description: The billable quantity equals the accepted quantity, with no cap from the forecast — a single order is created per acceptance.

RETENIR_PRODUCTION.label: Reserve for production
RETENIR_PRODUCTION.description: Confirms the quantity reserved for production from the announced forecast.

CONFIRMER_PREPARATION.label: Confirm preparation
CONFIRMER_PREPARATION.description: Confirms the quantity prepared for delivery, ready to be handed to the Store.

CONFIRMER_REMISE_MAGASIN.label: Confirm handover to the Store
CONFIRMER_REMISE_MAGASIN.description: Confirms the quantity handed over from Production to the Store. This transition proves the internal handover, not the customer's receipt.

CONFIRMER_CHARGEMENT.label: Confirm loading
CONFIRMER_CHARGEMENT.description: Confirms the quantity handed to the driver for the round and identifies the driver — does not prove the customer's receipt.

CONFIRMER_DEPART.label: Confirm departure
CONFIRMER_DEPART.description: Confirms that the driver is leaving on the round with the delivery. No quantity is entered at this step.

SIGNALER_DEPOT.label: Report drop-off at customer
SIGNALER_DEPOT.description: Reports that the delivery was dropped off at the customer. The accepted quantity is still to be confirmed separately — no financial effect at this step.

actionsDialog.aucunEffetFinancier: This action has no financial effect — only the acceptance confirmation, made from the Orders module, can make a quantity billable.
actionsDialog.chauffeurAide: Required to confirm loading — identifies who is taking charge of the delivery.

actionsDialog.erreurGenerique: Something went wrong while confirming this action. Try again in a moment.

acceptations.title: Acceptance confirmation
acceptations.subtitle: Confirms the accepted and returned quantity for each pending delivery — only this confirmation can create a billable order.
acceptations.descWrite: Enter the accepted and returned quantity separately for each dropped-off product, then confirm.
acceptations.descRead: Read-only — confirming acceptance requires write access on Orders.
acceptations.empty: No delivery awaiting confirmation for this date.
acceptations.dialogDesc: Enter the accepted quantity and the returned quantity separately for each dropped-off product. Any missing quantity is calculated by the server — it is never entered here.
acceptations.financialEffectWarning: This confirmation can create a billable order: only the ACCEPTED quantity becomes billable, never the returned quantity. A single order is created per acceptance.
acceptations.sumExceedsDeposited: Accepted + returned exceeds the dropped-off quantity ({{deposited}}).
acceptations.bonRetourne: The physical delivery note has been returned
acceptations.bonRetourneAlready: Physical note already returned and recorded.
acceptations.versionObsolete: This cycle was changed in the meantime by someone else. The data has been reloaded — check the current state before trying again.
acceptations.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while confirming this acceptance. Try again in a moment.
acceptations.successWithOrder: Acceptance confirmed — order #{{numero}} created for {{bacs}} billable crates.
acceptations.successWithoutOrder: Acceptance confirmed — no quantity accepted, no order created.

production.qualityDialogDesc: Account for the losses and record the quality control before permanently closing this production.

stocks.title: Stock
stocks.subtitle: Raw materials, movements and alert thresholds — the history is never altered.
stocks.historyDesc: Chronological log — entries and exits, never altered.
stocks.matiereEditDesc: Stock isn't edited here: use entry/exit movements.
stocks.matiereNewDesc: The starting stock will be logged as an "Initial stock" movement.
stocks.ingredientLinkDesc: Links this material to the quantities entered in Production (bags, packets, kg, liters) so stock decrements automatically on every outflow.

travailleurs.title: Workers
travailleurs.subtitle: Staff roster and daily clock-in — including staff without access to the application.
travailleurs.ficheDesc: The link to an account is optional — staff without app access also have a record.
travailleurs.clockInDesc: Status of the day for a worker — hours optional.
travailleurs.emailProDesc: Generates an @boulangerie-lomoto.com address that forwards to the employee's personal inbox (Cloudflare Email Routing). Final verification is done by the employee, via the link received by email — outside the app's control.
travailleurs.emailProPendingHelp: Waiting for the employee to click the verification link received by email. Auto-refreshes every 20 seconds.
travailleurs.absenceDesc: Declared reason and justification decision, kept separate from clock-ins.
travailleurs.declareAbsenceDesc: The decision (justified / unjustified) is made separately, once the record appears in the list.
travailleurs.nightShiftHint: Entry and exit can fall on two different days — useful for night shifts.
travailleurs.pointageDesc: Real entry/exit timestamp — natively handles night shifts spanning two days.
travailleurs.sanctionsDesc: Punishments and disciplinary deductions — distinct from automatic absence deductions, added to them in the payroll calculation.
travailleurs.sanctionDialogDesc: The amount is only asked for a deduction — a punishment is never financial.
travailleurs.paieDesc: Calculation detail, per worker and per month — every line can be checked.
travailleurs.paieSelectWorker: Select a worker and a month
travailleurs.noBulletins: No payslip issued for this worker.

etatSysteme.licenceHelp: No licensing system for now — it will arrive with the White label version.
etatSysteme.maintenanceDesc: Automatic daily backup written locally on the server, and download — automatic or manual — for a copy on a USB drive or external disk.

etatSysteme.iaDesc: Diagnostics for the Gemini API connection used by the Assistant's first line.
etatSysteme.resetDesc: Erases all data and all accounts to start fresh — irreversible. Configuration (roles/permissions, product catalog, raw materials, recipes, client types, shop settings) is kept.
etatSysteme.resetUnavailable: Reset is disabled on this environment — the server would refuse it.
etatSysteme.resetDialogDesc: A safety backup is created automatically before anything is erased. This action is irreversible.
etatSysteme.resetWarning: All business data and all accounts (including yours) will be erased. The app will restart on the first-launch assistant.
